audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text called the reflect a passive and breakdown.spikes named no Mel timing at all.
audit.why: The reflect/immunity is Rebuttal (W), cooldown 38/35/33/29/26. Mel's passive is Searing Brilliance: bonus projectiles on the next attack after any ability, plus infinite Overwhelm stacking that Golden Eclipse (120/100/80s, global) cashes in. Azir's spikes are level 6 Emperor's Divide (120/105/90s) and Nashor's Tooth.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text and breakdown.spikes rewritten to name Rebuttal, Golden Eclipse and the MR timing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: the matchup never named a single Mel ability. breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit.
audit.why: The decisive interactions are: (a) Rebuttal (W, 250 range) both prevents Mel taking damage and reflects projectiles, on 38s at rank 1 down to 26s at rank 5 — that cooldown is the whole green-light system for Azir's soldier poke; (b) Solar Snare (E, 1000 range, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s) roots at the centre and slows around it, which is what sets up her volley and denies your Shifting Sands exit; (c) Searing Brilliance loads bonus projectiles onto her NEXT attack after any ability, so the auto wind-up — not the cast — is the tell; (d) every point of chip you take stacks Overwhelm for Golden Eclipse, which reaches you at any distance (25000 range).
audit.corrected: Rebuttal and Solar Snare cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns; the auto-reset tell folded into the Do's; Overwhelm banking folded into feeding and early.

audit.why: Rebuttal 38/35/33/29/26, Solar Snare 11/10.5/10/9.5/9, Shifting Sands 22/20.5/19/17.5/16 are all in the kits.

edits.before: Mel's kit punishes aggressive trading thanks to her reflect passive, so avoid throwing needless poke into her and instead focus on safe soldier farming from max range. She out-trades you in raw poke damage in this window, so respect her cooldowns and don't overextend for CS. Ward tri-bush since she can set up poke angles you won't see coming otherwise.
edits.after: Rebuttal, not her passive, is the reflect — it prevents her taking damage for its duration, so never poke into it and farm with soldiers from max range. Her passive stacks Overwhelm on everything that hits you, and free chip now becomes Golden Eclipse damage at 6. Radiant Volley is a 10-second cooldown at rank 1; don't overextend for CS while it is up.

notes: CHART: phases[0..4].side were the stale token 'Skill' while content win[0..4] and packet.levelChart already read Mel/Mel/Mel/Mel/Azir. I moved the full layer onto the content layer's answer, so NO paired win[N] edit exists to propose — win[N] is already correct on disk for every row I touched. Each moved row's .why was rewritten in this same proposal. phases[].rating left untouched: the rating scale's owner-vs-enemy orientation is ambiguous on this page and moving it without knowing which side it describes would be a guess. breakdown.difficulty left alone (matches diff/diffRating/carryRating). Rebuttal's damage prevention and projectile reflect are stated from Riot's text only — whether Azir's Sand Soldier attacks count as projectiles for the reflect is NOT in the kit data, so nothing in the rewrite asserts it either way; the advice is keyed to Rebuttal's cooldown instead. Same for whether Solar Snare's root blocks a Shifting Sands cast: I wrote 'roots you to set up her volley', not a dash-denial claim.
